scope: Native release-0.8 group/rerun logs only; no Gradle, adb, app execution or visual approval performed by this auditor
method: Match class#method against current Android @Test sources, with 97 cases in each configured group
Count only explicit terminal instrumentation status 0 as PASS, never a START or a log summary alone
Later terminal events supersede earlier results for the same exact testcase-id; all prior failures remain in history
Terminal testcase PASS in an unfinished run is recorded with pass_from_incomplete_run=true, without claiming that run completed
Do not use older full08-01 results to fill pending cases in the current grouped acceptance
limitations: Source logs do not bind each testcase to an APK hash; this inventory is not proof that every case ran on the final release artifact
Passing native instrumentation does not replace visual review, physical microphone/GPS testing or a physical-phone service trial
Running logs are point-in-time snapshots with byte length and SHA-256; later output is not included until the inventory is regenerated

interruption.source: Root run report; no footer in log independently confirms incompleteness
